title: Proposed Construction row-semantic mutation campaign and allocation witness gap
status: PROPOSAL ONLY; no mutation execution, no production/test edits, no acceptance
existing_evidence_context: Parent reports current94-test/2293-assertion focus passing including12 public histories. This task did not rerun or independently accept that report. Tests here are inspected exact source, not new tests.
scope: Row semantic logic and one exact bridge column-code forwarding fault. Excludes prior26 projection/purity units, proposed55 metadata/schema units, static schema/catalog facts, source-key repair, live lifecycle implementation and save binding.
execution_protocol_proposal: Astra/QA inspect before adoption. Use a fresh isolated no-autoload clone, not integration checkout. Freeze every source/test hash listed; pending source-key repair may require an explicit refreeze even if row edits remain textually unchanged.

Each case is independent. Require every old string exactly once and replace once in the isolated source, without altering tests or fixtures. Replacements scoped as complete functions are intentional uniqueness context, not additional functional edits. Do not stack cases.

Run listed existing test method(s) through the actual existing test framework, preserving setup/assertion reporting. An author harness may select those methods but must not replace test bodies, rebuild weaker fixtures, rewrite expected values or count an uncalled method as execution.

Obtain clean unmutated baseline for the same methods first and after restoration. For each mutation require at least one specifically named assertion failure with expected baseline versus mutant code shown here. Additional safe assertion failures are permitted. A wrong numerical prediction here must be inspected, not silently broadened to any nonzero exit.

Parse/compiler warnings treated as errors, SCRIPT ERROR, invalid array access, missing method, missing summary, timeout, crash, allocation/fixture setup failure or a broken baseline are INVALID execution, not discriminating test failures. No forbidden type-gate omission that can index beyond frozen arrays is proposed.

For parameterized tests retain case id AND physical row position in raw assertion output. ROW_POSITIONS are0,1,41471,41472,82943; FLAG_POSITIONS0,1,41472,82943. They are multiple observations of one source mutation, not new fault units.

A full positive tuple matrix emits a large marker; keep raw log but summarize only failed semantic assertion and fixture tuple if diagnosing. The test oracle uses independent T_* facts; never substitute production COLUMN_* values.

Record source/test hashes, exact applied edit, method names, baseline/mutant assertion counts, exit status, clean-runtime check and main-source unchanged verification. A surviving mutant is a test-gap finding, never a pass. Do not widen to full project regression unless parent separately requests it.

Bridge functional/projection/input-equality tests cannot distinguish constructing default packed buffers then replacing them with borrowed columns; outputs are identical.
allocation_discriminator.search_result: Only generic godot/tools/memory_ledger_probe.gd and measure_memory_ledger.gd reference static-memory APIs; no Construction bridge adapter allocation/ballast witness found. Contract87 specifies one; specification is not execution.
allocation_discriminator.required_next_test_before_fault_is_eligi: Dedicated actual Bridge.framed_refusal path with valid shaped frame; allocate fixture before measurement; validate strictly positive Godot static-memory readings; establish ballast above previous process peak; measure incremental peak attributable to adapter and require <1048576. Keep record/view lifetime controlled. Invalid readings/engine errors invalidate result. Pair baseline and actual bridge default-image-allocation fault only after this witness exists.
allocation_discriminator.limits: Logical packed bytes are not measured native memory or RSS. Even an eventual1MiB discriminator cannot prove absence of one663552-byte copy; prior direct-purity/allocation obligations remain separate.

known_limits_not_claimed_covered: Current single-fault table has no isolated READY begun/remaining corruption. Do not claim that weakening READY relation is discriminated merely because valid READY rows pass.

Current table has WORKING zero but no isolated WORKING remaining>W or begun0 with correctly matching FULL policy; likewise no isolated WORK_DONE begun0/remaining0 with matching FULL policy. Omission mutants for these precise bounds are not proposed as caught without new negative witnesses.
REFUNDING unbegun short-work is covered; begun remaining>W is not separately represented. Positive boundary W does not prove rejection of W+1.
Enum negative values and some reference/value branches lack individual negative fixtures; this is a bounded meaningful campaign, not exhaustive branch coverage.

Removing BUILD/FURNITURE type guards or moving WORKERS before TYPE can cause out-of-bounds indexing on existing bad-type fixtures. Such runtime errors would not be valid mutation discrimination; use safe strict-domain positive mutants here instead.

No metadata facts mutated. Parent clarified exact types for all fact fields and numeric anchors only for gate-consumed values. Four StringName key failures and queued source-key repair belong to the separate metadata campaign.
Allocation witness absence remains a separate acceptance gate; no inference from94 passing functional tests or logical byte arithmetic closes it.

static func _declared_work_mwu_for_row(purpose: int, type_id: int) -> int:
	"""Frozen declared work W for a validated purpose/type pair, from the gate arrays alone.

	Callers must have already run the TYPE gate; an out-of-range pair returns 0, which the PHASE
	gate treats as a refusal rather than a valid zero-work project ("All W are positive").
	"""
	match purpose:
		PURPOSE_BUILD:
			if type_id < 0 or type_id >= BUILDING_KINDS:
				return 0
			return COLUMN_BUILDING_WORK_MWU[type_id]
		PURPOSE_FURNITURE:
			if type_id < 0 or type_id >= FURNITURE_KINDS:
				return 0
			return COLUMN_FURNITURE_WORK_MWU[type_id]
		PURPOSE_UPGRADE:
			var index: int = COLUMN_UPGRADE_IDS.find(type_id)
			if index < 0:
				return 0
			return COLUMN_UPGRADE_WORK_MWU[index]
		PURPOSE_DEMOLISH:
			if type_id < 0 or type_id >= BUILDING_KINDS:
				return 0
			return COLUMN_BUILDING_WORK_MWU[type_id] * DEMOLITION_WORK_NUM / DEMOLITION_WORK_DEN
	return 0
